title: What DORA measures and what it does not — the metric as a symptom

videos.script: A director reads that good teams deploy often. So she asks her teams to deploy more often. {{request}} It sounds like the shortest route to the result. It is a route around it. {{around}} The four DORA numbers are symptoms. They tell you about habits you cannot see directly. {{symptoms}} How small a change is. How fast it gets reviewed. How safely it ships, and how easily it comes back out. {{habits}} Change the habits, and the numbers move on their own. The Billing team never set a target, and all four improved. {{billing}} Push on the numbers without changing the habits, and only the numbers move. {{push}} This lesson is about what the four can see, what they cannot, and why they make a poor league table. {{lesson}} By the end you will read a DORA dashboard by its edges. What changed. How many events. And what is missing. {{edges}}
